results.title: ‘Feel honoured’: Meet the young gun umpire set for the big leagues
Infantino apologizes for World Cup furor
results.description: ZURICH -- Gianni Infantino apologized to FIFA's ruling council on Thursday for "mistakes" in his secretive investment plan for the World Cup but didn't give details sought by his toughest critics who want to oust him as the president of soccer's governing body.
